title: Rajaa and the Borrowed Faces
logline: Rajaa wears a hundred masks until Dunya asks to see the one beneath.
story: A hundred faces hung by the door, and Rajaa, for all of the turning of the heart, the hopeful return, wore a different one for every visitor. Then Dunya, who was the world and its pull, asked a single quiet question: which face do you wear when no one is watching? Rajaa had no answer, and that silence was more frightening than any crowd. So Rajaa began, slowly, to set the masks down one by one, and found beneath them not emptiness but a plain, unguarded face. It was the only face anyone had ever truly wanted to meet.
moral: The self you hide in order to be loved is the very self that love was looking for.
